title: 污水泵站堵塞預防
titleEn: Clogging prevention in sewage pump stations
summary: 以「污水泵站堵塞預防」為研究主題，規劃拆解物料與能量流程、處理單元、環境績效及驗證。目前為選題路線圖，逐步課程與專案細節尚待編審；所附通用來源屬類別背景。
summaryEn: Study topic: Clogging prevention in sewage pump stations. Planned coverage includes material and energy flows, treatment units, environmental performance and verification. Roadmap entry: step-by-step lessons and project details await editorial review; general references provide category context.
